answer.answer: The Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) [E01] helps job-seekers and established craftspeople launch small businesses outside agriculture. PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme launched in 2008 that aims to generate employment opportunities by supporting the establishment of new micro-enterprises in both rural and urban areas, promoting self-employment among traditional artisans, unemployed youth, and other eligible beneficiaries in the non-farm sector [E01].
